en.text: God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，求你将判断的权柄赐给王，

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，求你將判斷的權柄賜給王，

en.text: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.

zhSimplified.text: 他要按公义审判你的民，

zhTraditional.text: 他要按公義審判你的民，

en.text: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.

zhSimplified.text: 大山小山都要因公义使民得享平安。

zhTraditional.text: 大山小山都要因公義使民得享平安。

en.text: He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.

zhSimplified.text: 他必为民中的困苦人伸冤，

zhTraditional.text: 他必為民中的困苦人伸冤，

en.text: They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.

zhSimplified.text: 太阳还存，月亮还在，

zhTraditional.text: 太陽還存，月亮還在，

en.text: He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 他必降临，像雨降在已割的草上，

zhTraditional.text: 他必降臨，像雨降在已割的草上，

en.text: In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.

zhSimplified.text: 在他的日子，义人要发旺，

zhTraditional.text: 在他的日子，義人要發旺，

en.text: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 他要执掌权柄，从这海直到那海，

zhTraditional.text: 他要執掌權柄，從這海直到那海，

en.text: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.

zhSimplified.text: 住在旷野的，必在他面前下拜；

zhTraditional.text: 住在曠野的，必在他面前下拜；

en.text: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

zhSimplified.text: 和海岛的王要进贡； 和的王要献礼物。

zhTraditional.text: 和海島的王要進貢； 和的王要獻禮物。

en.text: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.

zhSimplified.text: 诸王都要叩拜他；

zhTraditional.text: 諸王都要叩拜他；

en.text: For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.

zhSimplified.text: 因为，穷乏人呼求的时候，他要搭救；

zhTraditional.text: 因為，窮乏人呼求的時候，他要搭救；

en.text: He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.

zhSimplified.text: 他要怜恤贫寒和穷乏的人，

zhTraditional.text: 他要憐恤貧寒和窮乏的人，

en.text: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.

zhSimplified.text: 他要救赎他们脱离欺压和强暴；

zhTraditional.text: 他要救贖他們脫離欺壓和強暴；

en.text: He will live; and Sheba’s gold will be given to him. Men will pray for him continually. They will bless him all day long.

zhSimplified.text: 他们要存活。 的金子要奉给他；

zhTraditional.text: 他們要存活。 的金子要奉給他；

en.text: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field.

zhSimplified.text: 在地的山顶上，五谷必然茂盛； ；

zhTraditional.text: 在地的山頂上，五穀必然茂盛； ；

en.text: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.

zhSimplified.text: 他的名要存到永远，

zhTraditional.text: 他的名要存到永遠，

en.text: Praise be to the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

zhSimplified.text: 独行奇事的耶和华—的 神

zhTraditional.text: 獨行奇事的耶和華－的上帝

en.text: Blessed be his glorious name forever! the whole earth be filled with his glory! and amen.

zhSimplified.text: 他荣耀的名也当称颂，直到永远。

zhTraditional.text: 他榮耀的名也當稱頌，直到永遠。

en.text: This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse.

zhSimplified.text: 的儿子—的祈祷完毕。

zhTraditional.text: 的兒子－的祈禱完畢。
